PREPARE BEFORE YOU ZONE IN

The pickup route

Start in Ironforge from wherever you are. If you’re in Stormwind, take the Deeprun Tram. This route batches the two mandatory city loops and leaves Flame Crest until Ragged John’s story is available. Check a step only after you do it in game.

See the Burning Steppes route sketch Two passes, timed to the quest chain
First field loop, before the city deliveriesLater: Ragged John + Flame Crest pickups, then back to Maxwell
You cannot pick up every BRD quest before your first entry. Windsor and Kharan unlock follow-ups inside. At 53, prepare the nine entry quests below; plan a key-and-bar visit, an outside turn-in and ingredient loop, then your deeper run. “Efficient” here means reducing avoidable travel under your known flight paths, not a timed speedrun.
